[[Banishing#Sovereign Banishing | Sovereign Banishing]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Banishing#Sovereign Banishing | Sovereign Banishing]]:''' On Hit: 4 to 24 [[Bane]] damage to [[Extraplanar|Outsiders]].
On [[Vorpal Strike|Vorpal Hit]]: If an outsider struck by this weapon has fewer than 3000 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the outsider has above 3000 Hit Points, it takes 300 damage.
